title: RenderWidgetChatOutput
description: Strict output contract for the chat-render pass: a short bot message plus one or more widget envelopes. Each envelope is validated against playbooks/widget-contract/_envelope.schema.json and its widget_type payload schema (the eval harness does the per-envelope schema check via the configured widget_schema_dir).

bot_message.description: Short conversational text; structured info lives in widgets.
